'''Canin''' is the captain of the ''[[Darter]]''.

==Appearance==
Captain Canin is as round as his ship.

==Activities==
After the ''[[Blue Crane]]'' runs up on a mud flat, [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Egwene al'Vere]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] walk to [[Jurene]] and find passage aboard Captain Canin's ship, the ''Darter''.{{ref/book|4|39}} He takes them down the [[River Erinin]] to [[Tear]].{{ref/book|4|48}}
